Title: Users may intermittently be unable to access their calendars in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook desktop client

User impact: Users may intermittently be unable to access their calendars in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook desktop client.

More info: Users get the error message, “Can’t retrieve calendar events right now. Refresh the browser and try again.”

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Exchange Online and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may intermittently be unable to access their calendars in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook desktop client

User impact: Users may intermittently be unable to access their calendars in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook desktop client.

More info: Users get the error message, “Can’t retrieve calendar events right now. Refresh the browser and try again.” Users can work around this issue by accessing their calendar in classic Outlook or through Microsoft Teams. 

Current status: We're currently reviewing telemetry and HTTP Archive format (HAR) log information as we investigate the cause of impact.

Scope of impact: Some users that attempt to access their calendars through Outlook on the web and new Outlook may be intermittently affected.

Next update by: Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 6:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may intermittently be unable to access their calendars in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook desktop client

User impact: Users may intermittently be unable to access their calendars in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook desktop client.

More info: Users get the error message, “Can’t retrieve calendar events right now. Refresh the browser and try again.” Users can work around this issue by accessing their calendar in classic Outlook or through Microsoft Teams.

Current status: We’re continuing to review service health telemetry and HAR logs to investigate what we suspect is a caching issue that’s leading to the impact. We’re also testing potential solutions to confirm our findings and determine our next steps.

Scope of impact: Some users that attempt to access their calendars through Outlook on the web and new Outlook may be intermittently affected.

Title: Users may be intermittently unable to access their calendars in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook desktop client

User impact: Users may be intermittently unable to access their calendars in Outlook on the web and the new Outlook desktop client.

More info: Impacted users may receive the following error message:

“Can’t retrieve calendar events right now. Refresh the browser and try again.”

As a workaround, impacted users can access their calendar in the classic Outlook desktop client or through Microsoft Teams.

Current status: We’ve identified that the issue is related to the calendar cache state following a refresh, where the event-loading process may continue referencing outdated calendar data after the folder information is updated.  We’ve implemented and merged a fix to ensure the refreshed calendar data is correctly used when loading subsequent events. The fix is expected to reach affected users by October 9, 2026.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to access their calendars through Outlook on the web or the new Outlook desktop client may intermittently be impacted.

Estimated time to resolve: Friday October 9, 2026

Root cause: The issue is related to the calendar cache state following a refresh, where the event-loading process may continue referencing outdated calendar data after the folder information is updated.

Next update by: Friday, October 9, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC
